title: Clearer event inspection and stable RCB export
titleId: Event Properties lebih jelas dan ekspor RCB tetap stabil
summary: ARSAS 1.6.41 adds a versioned native title bar, readable Event Log categories and a read-only auto-hiding Event Properties drawer. The established RCB Export Filter remains the default. The unfinished IED Browser and replacement RCB exporter are not part of this stable release.
summaryId: ARSAS 1.6.41 menambahkan versi pada title bar native, kategori Event Log yang mudah dipahami, serta drawer Event Properties read-only yang dapat tersembunyi otomatis. Form RCB Export Filter lama tetap menjadi alur utama. IED Browser dan exporter RCB pengganti yang belum selesai tidak ikut rilis stabil.
highlights: Window title reads the compiled installed version: ARSAS v1.6.41.
Operator Event categories include Spontaneous, GI, Integrity, Quality, Data update, Poll, State change and Buffer, where supported by decoded evidence.
Read-only Event Properties exposes acquisition, raw reason and RCB context in an auto-hiding drawer.
The original RCB Export Filter remains the production workflow; experimental Browser and exporter are excluded.
highlightsId: Judul window membaca versi aplikasi terpasang: ARSAS v1.6.41.
Kategori Event mencakup Spontaneous, GI, Integrity, Quality, Data update, Poll, State change dan Buffer apabila didukung bukti decoder.
Event Properties menampilkan sumber acquisition, reason mentah, dan konteks RCB dalam drawer read-only yang otomatis tersembunyi.
RCB Export Filter lama tetap menjadi workflow produksi; Browser dan exporter eksperimen tidak disertakan.
improvements: Public Windows installer and portable binaries are released with SHA-256 checksums, SPDX SBOM and source provenance.
Static DataSet monitoring remains report-only with no cyclic MMS process-value polling in that mode.
Package identity follows immutable GitHub Release v1.6.41 rather than a manually selected CI artifact.
Development work on the redesigned IED Browser and multi-RCB exporter remains isolated from the stable product.
improvementsId: Installer dan portable publik disertai checksum SHA-256, SPDX SBOM dan provenance source.
Mode monitoring Static DataSet tetap report-only tanpa polling MMS process-value siklik.
Identitas paket mengikuti GitHub Release v1.6.41 yang immutable, bukan artifact CI yang dipilih manual.
Pekerjaan IED Browser dan exporter multi-RCB baru tetap terisolasi dari produk stabil.
knownLimitations: Physical relay validation remains necessary for vendor-specific values, report behavior and field network conditions that cannot be reproduced by CI.
Windows x64 is the only packaged desktop platform in this stable release.
The public portable binary is not Authenticode code-signed; Windows SmartScreen may show an unrecognized-publisher warning.
Raw-Ethernet GOOSE and Sampled Values workflows require an administrator-installed and approved Npcap driver, suitable capture permission and visibility of the relevant multicast traffic.
knownLimitationsId: Validasi relay fisik tetap diperlukan untuk value vendor-specific, perilaku report, dan kondisi network lapangan yang tidak dapat direproduksi oleh CI.
Windows x64 adalah satu-satunya platform desktop yang dipaketkan pada stable release ini.
Binary portable publik belum ditandatangani dengan Authenticode; Windows SmartScreen dapat menampilkan peringatan unrecognized publisher.
Workflow raw-Ethernet GOOSE dan Sampled Values memerlukan driver Npcap yang telah dipasang dan disetujui administrator, capture permission yang sesuai, serta visibility traffic multicast terkait.

codeSigning.label: Not Authenticode-signed
codeSigning.detail: The current public Windows installer and portable binaries do not carry a commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verify the published SHA-256 value before use. SmartScreen warnings are therefore possible and are not hidden from users.
codeSigning.detailId: Installer Windows dan portable EXE publik saat ini belum memiliki commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verifikasi nilai SHA-256 yang dipublikasikan sebelum digunakan. Karena itu peringatan SmartScreen masih mungkin muncul dan status ini tidak disembunyikan dari user.
